# Manufacturer models — current status, 2026-10-07

U2, U6, U7, U8 and D21 are integrated in the isolated board suite. Samsung's CL05B104KO5NNN base-part model is integrated in a separate 0V-bias/25C AC comparison bench. Original vendor files and notices are retained. U7 uses a separate compatibility derivative; the original model fails its enable truth table in ngspice.

See [integration, source links, mappings, limitations and results](../integration-2026-10-07.md), [current manifest](manifest.json), and [download provenance](download-manifest-2026-10-07.json).

The current fourteen nominal benches completed; see ../static-integration-2026-10-07.md and ../../results_static_retest_2026-10-07.md. Selected U2/U6/U7 corners completed. Full vendor-reference qualification, KiCad GUI verification and hardware correlation remain pending.

[intake-before-integration-2026-10-07.md](intake-before-integration-2026-10-07.md) preserves the earlier search/probe report, including the original U7 failure and superseded download statuses. Historical audit files describe the pre-download state.

Keep vendor models local to the user's simulation work. Preserve terms and do not include them in public or manufacturing redistribution bundles without checking permissions; the D21 file expressly restricts unauthorized reproduction/communication.
